name: Crystal Crop Protection
summary: Crystal Crop Protection, founded in 1994, sells herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, bio-stimulants and seeds in India through more than 13,000 distributors and exports to over 19 countries. Revenue from operations was ₹2,691 cr in FY25, only about 3.5% a year above FY23 after a dip in FY24, while profit rose 35.7% to ₹118 cr and return on equity stayed low at 8.3%. Borrowings rose 55% over FY23–FY25 to ₹947 cr and reached ₹1,205 cr by September 2025, and about 78% of the ₹600 cr fresh issue in the draft papers goes to repaying debt. The price band, final issue size and post-issue holding are not yet announced, so valuation checks are unrated and this report uses DRHP figures.

fh1.finding: Revenue from operations went from ₹2,513 cr (FY23) to ₹2,691 cr (FY25), a CAGR of about 3.5%.

fh2.finding: Revenue fell to ₹2,230 cr in FY24 from ₹2,513 cr in FY23, then rose 20.7% to ₹2,691 cr in FY25.

fh3.finding: Debt to equity was about 0.78 at September 2025 (borrowings ₹1,205 cr vs net worth ₹1,538 cr).

fh4.finding: Borrowings rose 55% (₹613 cr to ₹947 cr) over FY23–FY25 while revenue rose only 7%.

fh5.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹1,252 cr, ₹1,325 cr, ₹1,424 cr (FY23–FY25) and ₹1,538 cr at September 2025.

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow figures were not found in public sources.

pr1.finding: Profit after tax grew 35.7% in FY25, to ₹118.4 cr from ₹87.2 cr.

pr2.finding: PAT margin improved from 3.0% (FY23) to 3.9% (FY24) and 4.4% (FY25).

pr3.finding: Return on equity was 8.31% in FY25.

pr4.finding: Public sources disagree on FY25 ROCE (16.4% on Chittorgarh, 9.7% on HDFC Sky), so it is not rated.

pr5.finding: Listed-peer margins were not found in public sources.

va1.finding: The price band has not been announced, so the post-issue P/E cannot be computed; listed peers trade at 17.8x–45.9x.

va2.finding: The price band has not been announced, so the post-issue price to book cannot be computed.

va3.finding: The price band has not been announced, so the post-issue market cap to sales cannot be computed.

va4.finding: No details of pre-IPO share issues or transfers were found in public sources.

pg1.finding: Promoters hold 86.69% before the issue; the post-issue holding is not yet published.

pg2.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

pg3.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

pg4.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters was found.

is1.finding: The OFS of 74.05 lakh shares cannot be valued until the price band is announced.

is2.finding: The issue as a share of post-issue market cap cannot be computed until the price band is announced.

is3.finding: Selling shareholders' acquisition cost was not found in public sources.

up1.finding: Unidentified acquisitions are grouped with general corporate purposes in the remaining ~22% of the fresh issue, so the growth share is not stated.

up2.finding: ₹465.6 cr of the ₹600 cr fresh issue in the DRHP (about 78%) goes to repaying debt of the company and its subsidiary Saffire Crop Science.

up3.finding: The amount for general corporate purposes has not been quantified.

up4.finding: Public sources don't say whose loans are being repaid.

lg1.finding: Litigation amounts were not found in public sources.

lg2.finding: No information on criminal or regulatory cases was found.

lg3.finding: Contingent liabilities were not found in public sources.

rk1.finding: Customer concentration figures were not found in public sources.

rk2.finding: Supplier concentration figures were not found in public sources.

rk3.finding: The company was founded in 1994, over 30 years ago.

rk4.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
